title: Acme × Northwind Client Check-in
summary: Monthly check-in with Northwind. Elena reported the integration is live in their staging environment and working well. The main open item is SSO: Northwind needs SAML support before they can roll out to production. Marcus confirmed SAML is on the roadmap and committed to a firm date by end of week. Both sides agreed to schedule a technical deep-dive on SSO for next week.

chapter_summaries.title: Integration Status & SSO Requirement
chapter_summaries.description: Elena confirmed the integration is live and working in Northwind's staging environment. Raj identified SAML single sign-on as the one item blocking a company-wide production rollout.

chapter_summaries.title: Commitments & Next Steps
chapter_summaries.description: Marcus committed to sending a firm SAML delivery date by end of week and the sides agreed to a technical deep-dive next week, with Raj preparing a staging-to-production checklist to review together.

action_items: Marcus Lee will send Northwind a firm SAML SSO delivery date by end of week.
Elena Petrova will schedule an SSO technical deep-dive for next week.
Raj Patel will prepare the staging-to-production migration checklist.
key_questions: When can SAML SSO be delivered?
What blocks the production rollout besides SSO?

turns.text: Hi Elena, Raj — thanks for the time. How's the integration looking on your side?
Good news: it's live in our staging environment and working well. The team's happy.
The one thing holding up production is single sign-on. We need SAML before we can roll out company-wide.
SAML is on our roadmap. Let me get you a firm date rather than a vague 'soon'.
A firm date would really help us plan the rollout internally.
I'll have a committed SAML date to you by end of this week.
Perfect. Could we also do a technical deep-dive so our identity team is ready?
I'll set that up for next week and send an invite.
Great. Raj, if you can prep a staging-to-prod checklist, we'll review it together on that call.

[Marcus Lee]: SAML is on our roadmap. Let me get you a firm date rather than a vague 'soon'.
